conditions: Kril only drops the three component blueprints; the main blueprint is a Market purchase.
If you picked Excalibur at the start of Awakening, you already own him.

groups.meta: ~4 kills for Systems; a few min a run
conditions: Phase 1: shoot the glowing blue coolant pack on his back to pop a pipe, then back off. He slams, freezes himself, and is damageable for a few seconds. Repeat four times; phase 2 is a plain damage race.
He never freezes while anyone, companions and specters included, stands in his face. Pubs who do this stall phase 1, so solo it.
No Cold or Heat: Cold extends his invulnerability and Heat thaws him early. Viral and Radiation work.
bonuses: Kril has a small Orokin Cell drop, and Out Of Sight is his rarest mod at 8.33%.
Staticor pops a tube with any hit near his upper back; Gara's Splinter Storm popped the first one instantly.

disclosures.title: when he will not freeze
disclosures.body: If he goes several cycles without freezing, restart; the next run is usually normal. Some players report the opposite trigger (close in so he swings the hammer), and breaking line of sight also triggers the slam. Leave Proboscis Cernos at home, since its stagger can permanently break phase 1, and do not use Harrow's Condemn, which locks him in an endless animation.

disclosures.title: wrong Kril, wrong boss
disclosures.body: The Ceres Kril with Vor on Exta drops Frost. Old guides naming Ambulas on Pluto are out of date; that is now Trinity.

disclosures.title: other sources
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, pick Excalibur in the normal Circuit during week 1 of the 11-week rotation: Neuroptics at tier 2, Chassis 5, Systems 8, main blueprint 10. Teshin also sells him fully built for 60,000 Conclave standing at Typhoon rank, by far the slowest route.

conditions: Each component costs 15,000 cr. Start each as it drops so the 12-hour timers overlap; have a free Warframe slot before claiming Excalibur.
